女体吸収－邪神に捧げられた肉贄

ちわー、魔法屋ですー！（三河屋っぽく）

そんなわけで、日本列島だいたいクソ寒いと思いますが皆様いかがお過ごしでしょうか。世間ではバレンタインがどうとか浮かれ騒いでおりましたが、結局は普段モテない奴がさらに肩身の狭い思いをするだけのイベントなので、何とかして撲滅できないものかと裏で密かに画策しております。

まあそんなことより絵の話ですが、今回は魔法屋がちょくちょくやってる融合モノです。女の子が女の子に呑み込まれるだけの話なので、魔法屋以外のどこに需要があるのかは謎なのですが。
とはいえ意外とご好評いただいており、魔法屋としてはありがたい限りです。

……あ、何の話かわからない人の為に、以前描いた似たような絵のリンク置いときます。

前々作 https://magicshop.fanbox.cc/posts/1672461

前作 https://magicshop.fanbox.cc/posts/3566693

で、ですね。
実は前作は個人的にやや反省点が多かったので、今回はその反省を活かしつつ、捕食する側の生命体はより魔物らしい異形の外見に。捕食される方も普段の生活を想像できるように、いったん制服を着せておくことにしました。
関係ない話ですが、少年漫画とかでヒロインが着ている服をビリビリに破られるシーンって興奮しないですか？ 魔法屋はします。

で、今回の捕食者は、なんか「堕ちた神」みたいな存在です。
古代には神として崇められていた存在が、力を失って異界で眠りについていたところ、なんか女の子が生贄に捧げられたので美味しく頂こうという感じの展開です。
生贄になった女の子はたまたま運悪く異界に落ちてきたのか、カルト教団の儀式か何かで生贄として捧げられたのか、手下の魔物がさらってきたのか、その辺りは例によって特に何も考えてないです。
まあ少なくとも生贄にされる本人にとっては不本意な状況らしく、散々悪態をつきながら融合されますが、捕食者の側にとってはその抵抗すら楽しみのひとつなのでしょう。

まあそんな感じで、女の子を同化とか捕食とか融合とかするやつは自分の性癖のルーツみたいなところがあるので、ちょくちょくやっていきたいのですがいかんせんやりたいことが多い！ 悪堕ちとかふたなりとか肉体改造モノもやりたい！ って状況なので、そんなに頻繁には出来ないですが、できればまたやりたいです。

ではまた、次の作品で。

Female Body Absorption －Sacrifice Offered to the Evil God

Chiwa, I'm a magician! ( Mikawaya-style)

So, it's probably pretty damn cold in the Japanese archipelago, but I wonder how everyone is doing. Valentine's Day has been causing a stir among the public, but in the end, it's just an event that makes people who aren't usually popular feel even more narrow-minded, so I'm secretly plotting something that can't be eradicated somehow.

Well, more about the pictures than that, but this time it's a fusion of things that the magician is doing little by little. Since the story is about girls being swallowed up by other girls, it's a mystery where the demand lies other than in the wizarding industry.
However, it has been surprisingly well received, which is a blessing for a magician.

...Oh, for those who don't know what to say, I'll put a link to a similar picture I drew before.

Previous works https://magicshop.fanbox.cc/posts/1672461

Previous work https://magicshop.fanbox.cc/posts/3566693

So, that's it.
In fact, I personally had a lot to reflect on in the previous film, so this time I'll use that reflection to improve the appearance of the creatures that prey on me to a more monster-like, deformed form. I decided to keep the prey in their uniforms for now so that they could imagine their normal lives.
On a related note, wouldn't you be excited by a scene in a shonen manga where the heroine's clothes are torn apart by someone who is completely torn? I'll be a wizard.

So, this predator is something like a "fallen god."
In ancient times, beings worshipped as gods lost their powers and fell asleep in another world, but a girl was sacrificed, so they decided to enjoy the meal.
Whether the sacrificed girl happened to be unlucky enough to have fallen into another world, was offered as a sacrifice in a cult ritual or something, or was kidnapped by a monster under her command, I don't really think about that in any particular way.
Well, at least for the person being sacrificed, it seems like an unwilling situation and is fused together with a lot of swearing, but for the predator, even that resistance is a fun thing to do.

Well, that kind of thing, when it comes to assimilating girls, or preying on them, or merging them, it's kind of the root of my own sexual preferences, so I want to do it little by little, but I often want to do it! I also want to do things like fall into evil or do physical modifications! That's the situation, so I can't do it that often, but I'd like to do it again if possible.

See you next time.
